title: Challenges in Annotating Datasets to Quantify Bias in Under-represented Society

bias_targets.methodology: Generating text using prefix templates slotted with New Zealand demographic identifiers (e.g., Māori, Pacific, NZ European) and manually annotating the language model outputs for 'regard' (positive, negative, neutral polarity), as well as analyzing associations with criminal activities and social stereotypes.

Analyzing the types of occupations (e.g., doctor, nurse, janitor, laborer) generated by the language model for different demographic groups and evaluating how annotators perceive and conflate economic status with positive or negative bias.
